title: ChatTranslate
description: This Plugin lets you choose between lots of Languages for the Chat to be translated to, you can also change it just for players.
body:
ChatTranslator
  ChatTranslator translates chat messages per viewer, so each player can read global chat in their own language.

  Features

  - Per-player chat language
  - Live translation in normal global chat
  - Supports many popular languages (DE/EN/FR/ES/NL/PL and more)
  - Fallback to original message if translation API fails
  - Cache for better performance
  - Configurable colored chat formats
  - Admin controls for managing player languages

  Commands

  - /ct on - Enable translation for yourself
  - /ct off - Disable translation for yourself
  - /ct lang <code> - Set your language
  - /ct languages - Show supported languages
  - /ct reload - Reload config (Admin)
  - /ct set <player> <lang> - Set player language (Admin)
  - /ct toggle <player> <on|off> - Enable/disable translation for a player (Admin)

  Permissions

  - chattranslator.use
  - chattranslator.admin

  Technical

  - Paper 1.21.x
  - Java 21
  - No Bungee/Velocity dependency required
